summaryZh: DigiHealth Lab 研究如何把健康监测从诊室扩展到日常生活，开发更连续、便捷、低成本的感测技术。方向包括无需额外硬件的智能手机健康筛查、新型可穿戴监测和无电池健康设备，并通过病房、家庭及其他真实使用环境中的原型测试评估技术。
researchQuestions: 如何利用手机及可穿戴设备，使诊室外健康监测更连续、便捷和低成本？
如何减少健康监测对额外硬件及电池的依赖，并在真实使用环境中验证原型？
topics: 移动健康与诊室外健康监测
手机贫血、认知功能和血压筛查及哺乳支持
methods: 无需额外硬件的智能手机感测
病房测试及带回家庭的真实使用场景研究

evidence.quote: The DigiHealth Lab is founded by Professor Edward J. Wang as a joint research laboratory of UCSD Design Lab and the Electrical & Computer Engineering department of Jacobs School of Engineering .

Our research focuses on developing new sensing techniques for monitoring a person's health more continuously, conveniently, and cheaply with the goal of ultimately bringing clinical sensing out of the clinic .

We are transforming smartphones into medical devices without any hardware add-ons to screen for anemia, cognitive disfunctions, blood pressure, and even assisting in breastfeeding; developing novel wearable devices that continuously track health and user context; and exploring new ways to support health monitoring devices without batteries.

Towards this goal, we have tested technologies in patient rooms, performed in-the-wild studies where users take our prototypes home, and even partnered with various NGOs to perform true user testing in places like the Peruvian jungle.
Edward Wang leads the DigiHealth Lab at UC San Diego's Design Lab and ECE department since 2019.
